Of these, five of these are considered the most significant, those of the Golden Joysticks, the Game Awards, the D.I.C.E. Awards, the Game Developer Choice Awards, and the BAFTA Games awards. Only two games have won all five in a given year: Baldur's Gate III in 2023 and Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 in 2025.
